name: Human Torch
summary: The Fantastic Four's hothead, literally. Johnny Storm, Sue's cocky younger brother, can burst into flame and fly, and he never misses a chance to show off.
origin: Johnny Storm is the little brother every team needs and nobody asked for. He tagged along with his sister Sue on Reed Richards's unauthorized rocket flight in Fantastic Four #1 in 1961, and cosmic rays let him burst into flame, fly and hurl fire. Stan Lee and Jack Kirby borrowed the name and the flaming gimmick from Carl Burgos's android Human Torch of 1939, from Marvel's Timely days, but swapped the robot for a cocky teenager. He can soak up heat as well as make it, and he has spent decades pranking the Thing. Underneath the showing off, he is fiercely loyal to his family.
powers: Flies when his body is aflame

storyline.title: The teenage torch
storyline.beat: Johnny Storm, Sue Storm's hot-headed teenage brother, sneaks onto Reed Richards's rocket flight. Cosmic rays let him burst into flame, fly and throw fire.

storyline.title: Strange Tales
storyline.beat: Johnny gets his own feature in Strange Tales, later sharing it with his best friend and sparring partner, the Thing.

storyline.title: Spider-Man's rival
storyline.beat: Johnny and the young Spider-Man meet early on and spend years as squabbling rivals before becoming genuine friends.

storyline.title: Married to a Skrull
storyline.beat: Johnny marries the sculptor Alicia Masters, only for the bride to be revealed later as Lyja, a shape-shifting Skrull who had replaced her.

storyline.title: Death in the Negative Zone
storyline.beat: Johnny holds off an invading army in the Negative Zone and is apparently killed, leaving the FF to grieve before he returns later the same year.

gossip.text: Johnny Storm was Marvel's first Human Torch.
gossip.truth: The first was an android, later named Jim Hammond, created by Carl Burgos for Marvel Comics #1 in 1939.

gossip.text: Chris Evans played Johnny in 2005 and 2007, years before he picked up Captain America's shield.
Johnny is the younger brother of Sue Storm, the Invisible Woman.
Johnny has been yelling "Flame on!" whenever he ignites since the early 1960s.
Johnny and the Thing trading pranks has been a running gag since the 1960s.

quiz.q: How is Johnny related to the Invisible Woman?
quiz.why: Johnny is Sue Storm's younger brother.

quiz.q: Which actor played Johnny in 2005 before becoming Captain America?
quiz.why: Chris Evans played the Torch in Fantastic Four (2005).

quiz.q: Who created the original 1939 Human Torch?
quiz.why: Carl Burgos created the android Torch for Marvel Comics #1.

timeline.title: Flame on
timeline.note: Fantastic Four #1 introduces Johnny Storm as Sue's hot-headed kid brother who can burst into fire and fly.

timeline.title: His own Strange Tales feature
timeline.note: Strange Tales #101 gives Johnny a solo strip, where he battles villains as a teen in a small town.

timeline.title: Meeting Spider-Man
timeline.note: The Amazing Spider-Man #1 brings the FF in, kicking off the long friendly rivalry between Johnny and Peter.

timeline.title: Cartoon hothead
timeline.note: The Hanna-Barbera Fantastic Four cartoon puts Johnny on TV for the first time.

timeline.title: Married to a Skrull
timeline.note: Fantastic Four #300 has Johnny wed Alicia Masters, who later turns out to be the Skrull spy Lyja.

timeline.title: Chris Evans flames on
timeline.note: The Fantastic Four film casts Chris Evans as a cocky, thrill-seeking Johnny.

timeline.title: Holding the line
timeline.note: Fantastic Four #587 has Johnny die holding back a horde from the Negative Zone, before a later return.

timeline.title: A new MCU Torch
timeline.note: Joseph Quinn plays Johnny in The Fantastic Four: First Steps, a retro-styled family adventure.
